baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled passive causative at words 2 and 7, joined to restraint at word 5 and a great allotted portion at words 10-11.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated passive presents the unknown object as an imparted competence. Taking or being taught it requires sustained self-restraint, while the allotted and magnified share marks unusual capacity rather than ordinary possession.

activation_trace.role: Taking in or teaching words supplies the literal image of a competence transmitted to a recipient.
Holding the self from reactive distress supplies the sustained condition for receiving and retaining the competence.
An allotted portion makes the competence a share that is possessed or granted.
Magnitude and force enlarge the allotted share into exceptional capacity.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified quality merely belongs to patient and fortunate people.
changed_reading.after: The verse profiles a competence one is made to receive and learn; restraint is its condition and the great share is unusual capacity for it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two passive occurrences of ل ق ي and the pairing of صبر with a magnified حظ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive can describe being brought face to face with something encountered as good or evil. Patience fits an encounter whose severity offers no easy exit, and the great allotment supplies the resources to remain oriented within it.

activation_trace.role: The meeting of confronting terms supplies the event structure of being brought face to face with the unknown object.
What a person meets of good or evil makes the receipt an undergone encounter rather than a static possession.
Severity with no outlet supplies the pressure under which patient orientation is tested.
The allotted share supplies the resources carried into the encounter.
Great size and force mark those resources as exceptional.

changed_reading.before: Patience is simply rewarded after difficulty.
changed_reading.after: The line can profile the demanding encounter itself: one is enabled to meet it only through restraint backed by an exceptional allotment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ل ق ي causative at words 2 and 7, read with restraint and a great share.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch in which two ends are made to meet permits the unknown object to be a joining operation. Self-restraint prevents rupture while an ample allotment supplies the rare capacity to hold opposed terms together.

activation_trace.role: Making two ends meet supplies a literal joining operation for the repeated causative.
Self-restraint supplies the nonrupturing hold needed while opposed ends are joined.
The allotted portion supplies a finite relational capacity.
Magnitude marks the joining capacity as unusually large and forceful.

changed_reading.before: The unknown feminine object is a private virtue.
changed_reading.after: It may be an operation that joins opposed ends; patience supplies nonrupture and the great share names rare relational capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding instruction supplies the unknown object: an asymmetric counter-response that removes harm by transmitting a better act. Patient self-restraint controls the outgoing response long enough for enmity to reverse into unbroken proximity.

activation_trace.role: Transmission and uptake make the better response an imparted practice rather than a spontaneous temperament.
Self-restraint supplies the gate that prevents injury from dictating the answer.
The allotted share marks this response capacity as granted and rare.
Doing what is good supplies the positive action substituted for mirrored injury.
Removing an unwelcome thing supplies the directed counter-force applied through the better act.
Explicit enmity supplies the initial social state that the practice must transform.
Nearness without an intervening gap supplies the reversed relational state.

structural_cues: 41:34 places unequal good and bad, an imperative, and an immediate enemy-to-ally reversal directly before the doubled exclusive clauses of 41:35.
The singular feminine pronoun in both passive clauses can reach back to the better mode of response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitution of a better act for harm and the resulting relational reversal; I infer that restraint governs the response interval and enables that reversal. A live alternative is that patience only qualifies receipt of a divine gift.

changed_reading.before: The verse commends an unspecified patience-dependent competence.
changed_reading.after: It names the rare, imparted ability to answer harm non-symmetrically so that the relation itself can reverse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The relation that lies between two parties is not erased but reconfigured: a hostile interval becomes no-gap proximity and kin-like closeness. The focus causative can therefore picture making two opposed ends meet, while patience holds the interface during the conversion.

activation_trace.role: Making two ends meet supplies the joining operation activated by the relational reversal.
Self-restraint supplies continuity at the interface instead of reciprocal rupture.
The share becomes a relational capacity and also a portion of restored relation.
A connection standing between endpoints supplies the span on which the change occurs.
Nearness without separation supplies the collapsed distance between former opponents.
Kin-like closeness intensifies proximity into an intimate social bond.

structural_cues: 41:34 repeats the between-relation before naming its opposite endpoint, and 41:35 immediately repeats the same exclusive passive construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an intervening relation, hostility, no-gap proximity, and intimate closeness; I infer that the causative reception can function as joining the endpoints. The live alternative is a moral transformation with no spatial joining force in the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: Joining two ends was an unassigned lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: The focus can describe the rare capacity to keep hostile endpoints in contact until their intervening relation becomes intimate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following conditional exposes a failure mode and a repair. Relation-corrupting provocation attempts to seize the response interval; refuge relocates the responder into protective attachment, making patience an interruption and redirection procedure rather than mute suppression.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint supplies the pause in which a provocation can be redirected.
Receiving an imparted response supplies what becomes available after the interruption.
Agitation that corrupts relations supplies the intrusive force that would restore reciprocal hostility.
Seeking protective attachment supplies the concrete redirection that preserves the better response.

structural_cues: 41:36 follows the focus with a conditional keyed to an intrusive impulse and an imperative response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies relation-corrupting agitation followed by refuge; I infer that refuge operationalizes the self-restraint required in 41:35. The live alternative is that 41:36 is a separate safeguard after, rather than a mechanism within, the granted practice.

changed_reading.after: Patience is an active interrupt: refuse the injected hostile impulse, attach to protection, and thereby keep the better response receivable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A surah-wide delivery corridor surrounds the focus: communication is sent down, upright people are visited by descending agents, prepared hospitality is supplied, and communication is again described as delivered. The doubled focus passive occupies the recipient side of that corridor, making the great share hosted provision rather than self-production.

activation_trace.role: Taking in something taught supplies the receptive center of the repeated deliveries.
An allotted portion supplies the form in which hosted provision belongs to the recipient.
Delivery from above establishes the opening giver-to-recipient direction.
Upright steadiness supplies the stable posture of those about to receive a descent.
Descent and settling supply an arrival upon the steadfast recipients immediately before the focus.
Prepared hospitality turns reception into provision readied for one who arrives.
A later delivery repeats and closes the same giver-to-recipient direction.

structural_cues: 41:2 and 41:42 bracket the central sequence with delivery language; 41:30-32 place uprightness, descent, and hospitality immediately before 41:35.
Both focus clauses are passive and exclusive, keeping the giver implicit while foregrounding qualified recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated downward delivery, upright recipients, and prepared hospitality; I infer that the focus passive participates in the same directional economy. The live alternative is that its pronoun refers only to the better response in 41:34.

changed_reading.before: The great share is an innate stock of moral talent.
changed_reading.after: It is also hosted provision: a steadfast recipient is made able to take in what descends and is prepared for them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, failed reception progresses from refusal and self-described barriers to deliberate acoustic interference used as a tactic of domination, then to a call experienced as remote. Against this pattern, patient reception is the capacity to keep meaning entering, understood, and actionable despite pressure to block or drown it.

activation_trace.role: Taking in taught words supplies the focus-side act threatened by interference.
Sustained self-restraint keeps reception open instead of reacting to noise by closure.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the deeper reception that is refused.
Weight in the ear supplies an internal obstruction to uptake.
Prevention of access supplies the declared interpersonal barrier.
Mixed clamor supplies deliberate interference with the communicative signal.
Overpowering force makes blocked hearing a strategy for domination rather than mere inability.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies what successful reception conveys.
Healing supplies the restorative effect of what enters successfully.
The repeated ear-weight confirms obstruction as a persistent reception pattern.
Distance from nearness turns an available call into one experienced as remote.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from not hearing in 41:4, through barrier claims in 41:5 and engineered noise in 41:26, to guidance and healing versus remote calling in 41:44.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refusal, obstruction, deliberate clamor, domination, guidance, healing, and distance; I infer that patience sustains semantic uptake under interference. The live alternative is that the focus receipt is purely ethical performance, not communicative reception.

changed_reading.before: Receiving the practice is a single moment of instruction.
changed_reading.after: It is durable receptivity: keeping meaning audible, intelligible, and effective while social pressure tries to obstruct it.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier occurrence allows endurance to coexist with a ruinous abode, so lexical persistence alone cannot be the qualifying mechanism. The immediate better-response instruction gives patience a direction: it is restraint deployed to remove harm through good, not brute durability inside any chosen course.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint supplies the morally directed control required by the focus.
Endurance within severity with no outlet shows that persistence can remain trapped in a destructive destination.
A concretely good act supplies the direction that distinguishes qualifying patience.
Removing harm supplies the outcome toward which restraint must work.

structural_cues: 41:24 uses the same focus root in a condemned trajectory, while 41:34 places a directed good action immediately before 41:35.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies same-root endurance with no saving outcome and later restraint adjacent to a better action; I infer that the focus patience is directionally qualified. The live alternative is that 41:24 presents only a futile hypothetical, not a real species of patience.

changed_reading.before: Any sufficiently long endurance satisfies the focus condition.
changed_reading.after: The qualifying patience is selective self-restraint ordered toward removing harm by good; bare persistence can preserve a destructive course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late human portrait treats adverse contact as total loss of hope and favorable change as private entitlement, then turns aside under blessing. Read against those switches, the great share is not a large quantity of favorable circumstance but the capacity to receive changing allotments without despair, appropriation, or relational withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: An allotted portion supplies the semantic object whose meaning is tested against changing fortune.
Magnitude shifts from quantity of goods toward strength of capacity.
Self-restraint supplies stability across favorable and adverse changes.
Cutting off hope supplies the first collapse produced by adverse contact.
A second image of severed hope intensifies the instability under harm.
Harm and diminution supply the adverse condition later replaced by relief.
Favorable condition and blessing supply the opposite circumstance that also destabilizes orientation.
Drawing one's side away supplies the posture of withdrawal under blessing.
Distancing and estrangement turn favorable possession into relational separation.

structural_cues: 41:49-51 repeatedly alternate harm and good, including the possessive claim in 41:50 and bodily turning-away language in 41:51.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies abrupt despair, entitlement after relief, and withdrawal under blessing; I infer that the great share names stable non-possessive capacity rather than abundant luck. The live alternative is a straightforward future reward allotted to the patient.

changed_reading.before: A great share means a large amount of favorable fortune.
changed_reading.after: The greater share is steadiness toward allotment itself: neither harm severs hope nor benefit becomes a basis for entitlement and withdrawal.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, the same root opens two terminal possibilities: forced casting into fire and the meeting doubted at the surah's close. The central passive receipt can therefore be formation for how one enters an unavoidable encounter, not merely acquisition of a local social technique.

activation_trace.role: Confronting meeting supplies the focus-side potential for an encounter trajectory.
Self-restraint supplies the formation that changes one's mode of entering the encounter.
The allotted share supplies what the formed recipient carries toward the encounter.
Being cast or placed supplies the involuntary terminal mode contrasted with safe arrival.
Meeting supplies the surah-closing horizon toward which reception and placement point.

structural_cues: 41:40 contrasts one cast into fire with one arriving secure, while 41:54 closes on doubt about meeting; both reuse the focus root after 41:35.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same-root sequence of receipt, casting, and final meeting; I infer that the granted practice forms a mode of arrival. The live alternative is that the later occurrences are independent lexical senses with no designed trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The demanding encounter is an unspecified present ordeal.
changed_reading.after: Receiving the practice may prepare how one is brought into the final encounter: formed for secure meeting rather than merely subjected to forced placement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps social discipline onto soil and water. It remains anchored in the focus's passive delivery, restraint, and allotted share, while 41:39 supplies a dormant recipient that stirs and grows after delivered water. Render it only as a material analogy for delayed efficacy, not as a grammatical resolution of the feminine pronoun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive receipt at words 2 and 7, patient holding at word 5, and allotted portion at word 10.

activation_trace.role: Delivery or placement supplies an input received rather than an effect manufactured immediately.
Self-restraint supplies the interval between reception and visible effect.
An allotted portion supplies the productive input or capacity held by the recipient.
Low dormant earth supplies a recipient whose capacity is initially invisible.
Delivery supplies the directional arrival of the activating input.
Water conveyed by pouring supplies the material received by the dormant ground.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supplies the first visible change after reception.
Nourishment and growth supply the delayed enlargement of the received share.
Earth made living through rain and growth supplies the completed transformation.

changed_reading.before: The better response should produce an immediate visible social result.
changed_reading.after: Patient receipt may work like dormant ground receiving water: the great share is latent productive capacity whose movement and increase appear later.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats the ethical capacity as something gestated and delivered. It remains anchored in passive placement, patient holding, and allotment, while 41:47 supplies enclosed fruit, inner bearing, emergence, and birth. Render it as an incubation analogy only, not as a claim that the focus words lexically mean pregnancy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated passive delivery, the holding force of صبر, and the possessed share in the focus.

activation_trace.role: Placement and delivery supply the endpoint of a capacity borne before it appears.
Patient holding supplies the incubation interval.
The allotted share supplies what is carried toward maturation.
Emergence from concealment supplies the transition from latent to manifest capacity.
Ripe fruit supplies maturation rather than instant production.
A plant's enclosing sheath supplies protected latency.
Inner bearing of pregnancy or fruit supplies sustained hidden carriage.
Laying down a carried burden through birth supplies eventual delivery into manifestation.

changed_reading.before: The rare capacity is either present or absent at the moment of provocation.
changed_reading.after: It may be received through patient incubation: enclosed, carried, ripened, and only then delivered as effective conduct.

strongest_changes: 41:34 resolves the leading reading toward an asymmetric counter-response that can reverse enmity rather than mirror it.
41:36 turns patience into an operational interrupt through refuge from relation-corrupting provocation.
The descent and hospitality sequence makes the repeated passive a reception event and the great share hosted provision.
41:24 and 41:49-51 prevent reducing patience to bare persistence or the great share to abundant good fortune.
The repeated ل ق ي in 41:40 and 41:54 extends local ethical reception toward a larger trajectory of placement and meeting.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context preserved several distinct mechanisms: response substitution, relational joining, protected reception, stability across fortune, and encounter preparation. The soil-growth and gestation patterns remain contained exploratory analogies because they reveal delayed efficacy without overriding the immediate antecedent.
remaining_uncertainties: The feminine pronoun may point narrowly to the better response of 41:34 or more broadly to a gifted capacity enacted there.
The great share may name prior endowment, the enacted capacity, the transformed relationship, or a later allotment.
The receipt-casting-meeting sequence may be a designed root arc or independent uses of the same root.
The germination and gestation models are materially coherent but do not determine the pronoun grammatically.
